body: 66fb3885. Two defects fixed: (1) FightHitCam.trigger() now takes landed array param - caller passes FightBeatAdapter.LANDED_CONTACTS, no more hardcoded word list. Test uses engine words (missed, slipped, blocked, clean, glancing, absorbed). (2) Camera aim: reposition along camera-to-bone line at zoomed distance, aim at bone - head now centered in frame. Stills in docs/previews/hit_cam/: 02_at_hold HUD reads 'absorbed' (landed), head at frame centre. Gates: parse clean, hit_cam 26/26, world 6/6, room 2/2, camera 2/2.
